display_title: To Those Who Long for My Destruction
description:
From parents forcibly married, whose only shared passion is mutual disdain, a neglected child is born—Leoni. Yearning for affection as a child, Leoni loses her mother to illness, only for her father to auction her hand in marriage. Enduring three arranged marriages, Leoni faces further hardship when she is falsely accused of a capital offense, seemingly destined for a bitter end. 

*"Those who orchestrated my misery... Every single one of them... shall pay...!"*

Perhaps by force of will, Leoni finds herself back in childhood, with memories intact—and her ire. Now, she must reclaim her life and seek long-awaited happiness. But first, there are debts of suffering to be paid. And Leoni is coming to collect.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)
